medien.en: Medien (word): the ''mediae'' consonants, 'b', 'd', and 'g'. (e.g. those subject to the Medienverschiebung).

pflaster.en: Pflaster (word): plaster, cement, mortar, a mixture of gypsum, sand and chalk applied to floors

zuhaufe.en: in droves, in large numbers or quantities

trachteten.en: Trachteten (word): a style of clothing or appearance, chiefly one that is typical of some group, region or age

entstehen.en: to come into being, to arise, to be produced

umkomme.en: Umkomme (word): to die, to be killed

angetan.en: be taken with something; have taken a shine

mitteilen.en: to inform about, to tell, to disclose, to impart, to report, to announce

schreiens.en: to shout; to yell; to cry; to scream; to howl
